workstream: New palettes, SVG design elements, patterns and image materials
mode: Market research only. No asset imports, catalog changes, media downloads, remote code execution, commits or pushes.

searchAccounting.definition: Sum of requested Exa numResults across all 11 search calls, including no retries. This is a review budget, not 90 unique validated sources.

conclusion.broadDesignAssetSupply: A large provisional supply exists when static icon geometry and raster texture materials are in scope. It does not establish 3,926 or 4,214 accepted assets with no similarity to the current catalog.
conclusion.paletteAndPatternOnly: The measured new core palette/shape inventories are small. They cannot support the required increment on their own.
conclusion.reason: Different publishers can contain the same palette; common patterns and icons may repeat existing geometry; photographic/procedural materials can be neighboring versions of one surface. All net yields need cross-source and baseline checks.

provisionalPools.name: Scientific Colour Maps / cmcrameri
provisionalPools.countUnit: 39 continuous named maps; 21 S categorical reorderings are variants of their original families, not extra cards. Reversals and resampling are also variants.
risks: Near maps such as related batlow variants may collapse further
256-color source arrays exceed the current 32-color palette field; an adapter must preserve the original full map rather than split it into cards
scico and other wrappers reuse this same provider and are not additive

provisionalPools.name: cmocean
provisionalPools.countUnit: 22 named base maps from cmapnames, not 44 original/inverted RGB files, generated reversals or map sampling levels
risks: Related or grayscale maps need comparison with existing arrays and new scientific maps
Preserve a full map as one asset; do not count 256 samples separately

provisionalPools.name: Colorcet
provisionalPools.countUnit: 93 static 256-row palette lists parsed with Python AST without execution; 11 _s25 cyclic phase shifts grouped with their base maps. Short names/CET aliases, Bokeh/Matplotlib exports and reversed maps are not additional assets.
risks: Contrast/chroma variants can remain close despite distinct source names
Official 100+ claim includes a broader registration surface and is not used as a base-asset count
Full-map data support and original attribution are required

provisionalPools.name: Wes Anderson / karthik
provisionalPools.countUnit: One authored palette family. Rushmore1/Rushmore share an exact array; Zissou1Continuous is grouped with Zissou1; Royal2 is already present as NBA Spurs.

baselineSampleCheck.method: Canonical RGBA, exact order and multiset, plus same-size Hungarian-matched Euclidean OKLab*100 over black and white, mean<=1 and max<=2. All original palette variants and static gradient originals included.
baselineSampleCheck.limitations: Does not cover different-size subset/resampling or all semantic palette similarities. A passing numerical sample is not a blanket uniqueness guarantee.

provisionalPools.name: Hero Patterns
provisionalPools.countUnit: 87 distinct name fields in the live first-party source, parsed as text without executing JavaScript. Color and opacity controls are not assets.
risks: Stripes, dots, checkers and simple grids may repeat Temani CSS Pattern geometry already stored
JavaScript wrappers describe MIT code but the underlying original SVG patterns use the creator's CC BY license

provisionalPools.name: Coolshapes / realvjy
provisionalPools.countUnit: First-party README lists 115 shapes in 10 categories. SVG, PNG, React and Figma versions are one asset each.
risks: Related abstract silhouettes may be rotations or small geometry changes
Noise/filter/gradient SVG preview needs compatibility and sanitization checks

provisionalPools.name: Subtle Patterns
provisionalPools.countUnit: 540 pattern posts reported by the first-party catalog, not retina-size outputs or download formats
provisionalPools.license: Original source repository: CC BY-SA 3.0. Current submission page says Creative Commons without a version; verify per-asset source and attribution before importing new uploads.
provisionalPools.eligibility: Conditional per-asset provenance/license confirmation; no accepted yield counted
risks: Explicit dark/light/outline counterparts already visible in official list
Raster preview/image-kind support required
Current site contains uploads newer than the historical source repository

provisionalPools.name: Kenney targeted design and VFX packs
provisionalPools.countUnit: First-party pack Files fields are raw design-file claims, not proven independent geometries. Pattern Lines author says 30 patterns in two line weights. Older UI pack descriptions also include color variants.
provisionalPools.eligibility: Targeted packs only; source geometry and color/style/frame variants must be grouped before accepting cards
risks: The 60,000+ all-in-one count combines game sprites, 3D models, audio, fonts and multiple formats and is excluded
Smoke/frame-by-frame sprites must be one effect, not one asset per frame
UI palette and pressed-state variations can collapse heavily
Raster support may be required

provisionalPools.name: ambientCG materials
provisionalPools.countUnit: Material IDs grouped into connected components using the API's explicit variations edges. A material is one candidate, not its color/normal/roughness/displacement maps, PNG/JPG formats or 1K/2K/4K/8K sizes.
provisionalPools.eligibility: Scope-sensitive: static texture/design material assets, not independent motion effects; requires image asset schema and previews
risks: 1,366 material records reference parent assets, often shared Substance generators; distinct material IDs can be minor parameter variations
Grouping explicit variations does not resolve visual similarity or cross-provider duplicates
Further filtering should prefer materially distinct patterns and surfaces suitable for motion graphics

provisionalPools.name: Poly Haven textures
provisionalPools.countUnit: 867 keys from the live texture-type API. One material family candidate per key, not PBR channels, resolutions, previews, or file formats. Models and HDRIs are excluded.
provisionalPools.eligibility: Scope-sensitive: static photographed texture/design materials, not independent motion effects; requires image asset schema and previews
risks: Adjacent surface samples such as _01/_02 may be very similar
Cross-source visual overlap with ambientCG is unassessed
Live API conditions and origin identification should be preserved independently of the asset license

provisionalPools.name: Lucide
provisionalPools.countUnit: SVG files in the original icons directory, not framework exports. This is a pre-family-filter ceiling, not 1,870 distinct concepts.
provisionalPools.license: ISC; preserve LICENSE including any upstream notices
provisionalPools.eligibility: Scope-sensitive design assets. Do not describe static icons as motions; prefer actual new geometry rather than a restyled instance of an existing Line-MD icon.
risks: Common concepts overlap Line-MD and other icon sets
Off/on, add/remove, stroke and small companion marks need family grouping
No sample SVG rendering or full-baseline path comparison was performed

provisionalPools.name: Phosphor
provisionalPools.countUnit: 1,512 icon names in each of six weights, not 9,072 separate cards; weights are family variants. Additional concept modifiers and deprecated aliases still need grouping.
provisionalPools.eligibility: Scope-sensitive static design geometry; compare meaning and actual shapes against Line-MD, Lucide and root's Tabler workstream before accepting
risks: Overlaps familiar icon concepts with other sets
Weight variants collapse to one family
No sample SVG rendering or full-baseline path comparison was performed

excludedOrUncounted.name: SVG Backgrounds
excludedOrUncounted.reason: Original license restrictions prohibit standalone redistribution/sharing, competing products and certain automated systems. Existing reference link is not a new stored-asset pool.

excludedOrUncounted.name: Book of Shapes
excludedOrUncounted.reason: License excludes redistribution of patterns as patterns, SVG packs, template libraries or generators. Eight category counts total 116, but none are counted as redistributable warehouse assets.

excludedOrUncounted.name: fffuel generated images
excludedOrUncounted.reason: Default image license prohibits redistribution. Specific tools such as dddynamite explicitly mention MIT and may qualify as exceptions, but exact source inventory/provenance for those exceptions was not established here. General tool output is not an infinite asset reserve.

excludedOrUncounted.name: Palettable, scico, cmocean ports and Colorcet aliases
excludedOrUncounted.reason: These largely wrap already counted original scientific maps or existing CARTO/ColorBrewer sources; wrappers, resampled lengths, reverse exports and language ports are not additive.

excludedOrUncounted.name: Kenney all-in-one advertised 60,000+
excludedOrUncounted.reason: Mixed game sprites, 3D, audio, fonts, resolutions, sheet/individual and vector/raster formats; no motion-relevant geometry net count established.

excludedOrUncounted.name: Reicon 71,000 aggregate and Inkjet 500 parametric patterns
excludedOrUncounted.reason: Root workstream flags unverified third-party provenance or ambiguous generator-template variants. No count in this workstream.

excludedOrUncounted.name: Already ingested palette and CSS pattern projects
excludedOrUncounted.reason: Nice Color Palettes, CARTO, ColorBrewer, Palettetown, Radix, Color Lisa, MetBrewer, PrettyCols, colRoz, poisonfrogs, NBA, uiGradients and Temani CSS Pattern are excluded as new supply.

totals.warning: These totals measure candidate units at different validation stages. Do not sum them into a guaranteed yield, add them to catalog totals, or use gross counts as evidence that all 3,926/4,214 required additions will survive deduplication. Tabler is owned by the root workstream and excluded here to prevent cross-workstream double counting.

accessLimitations: GitHub public API rate limit was reached on later tree queries. Successful earlier trees were complete with truncated=false. Later failure does not affect already observed inventories.

No standalone raster/SVG assets or motion frames were collected or rendered for visual comparison. Counts are live API/source metadata (including text-only JS/AST inspection) plus the bounded Wes palette numerical sample.
Future source versions can change the counts; pin the recorded original commits or remeasure at ingestion.
